subject: ggplot2 Case Study Competition winners announced!

messages.author: 17652242ec236632
messages.subject: ggplot2 Case Study Competition winners announced!
parts:
Hi all,

I am very happy to announce the winners of the 2nd ggplot2 Case Study Competition (list at http://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/wiki).  The winners are:

Crime in Downtown Houston, Texas : Combining ggplot2 and Google Maps, David Kahle, Rice University - Grand prize
Raman Spectroscopic Grading of Gliomas, Claudia Beleites, TU Dresden & Uni. Trieste - Finalist
Mapping electrical activity in the human neocortex, Michael Lavine, UMass Amherst - Finalist

David will receive a 32 GB ipod touch donated by Revolution Analytics
Claudia and Michael will each receive a UseR book of their choice.

Congratulations to everyone who entered. Thank you for sharing your ideas with the ggplot2 community!  

The entries showcase many new ways to enhance and apply ggplot2. I encourage everyone to explore all of the entries at http://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/wiki, and to further develop the ggplot2 wiki.


Regards,

Garrett
